elements.text: Matisse struggled with the creation of the Blue Nudes, which was an arduous process.

elements.text: Matisse aimed to unite color and drawing in his work, which was a lifelong challenge.

elements.text: Matisse’s cut-outs, including Blue Nude II, often appear effortless, but the work was arduous and sometimes he struggled.
